name: cs-navigator
description: Route capability-selection questions and bundle a small set of evidence-tracked chat-native CS skills.

interface.longDescription: CS Navigator routes capability-selection questions to the smallest useful evidence-backed set and now bundles four lightweight chat-native workflows: Language Bridge, Impact Map, Resilience Plan, and Adaptive Experiment. Ordinary direct tasks should still stay with ChatGPT when no skill is needed.
defaultPrompt: Tell me whether this task needs a bundled capability or ChatGPT can handle it directly.
Find the smallest useful bundled CS capability for this goal.
Check whether this external skill has enough evidence to trust.
